# Card

The bordered container the thank-you page is built from: 1px border, 12px corners, 16px padding in the body.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/card)

## Usage

```tsx
<Card>
  <CardBody>
    <Heading level={3}>Your order is confirmed</Heading>
    <Text>We’ve emailed you a confirmation with your order number.</Text>
  </CardBody>
</Card>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Card children` | `ReactNode` | Media goes straight inside; text goes in a CardBody. |
| `CardBody children` | `ReactNode` | Padded 16px. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Card.module.css`
- `Card.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
